item.title: Rich Bernhardt, Evergreen Engineering Co-Founder, Loses Cancer Battle
item.description: The co-founder of Evergreen Engineering, Richard Paul Bernhardt, died January 19 after a courageous four-and-a-half-year battle with pancreatic cancer.

item.title: U.S. Lumber Coalition Taps Steve Swanson For Chair, Again
item.description: Steve Swanson, recently named the Timber Processing 2026 Person of the Year, has for the second time assumed the role of Chairman of the U.S. Lumber Coalition.

item.title: Weyco Expects Strong Growth | Timber Processing
item.description: Weyerhaeuser Co. hosted an Investor Day in December and outlined the company's strategic growth plan and financial targets through 2030.

item.title: Canfor Announces Non-Cash Asset Write Down, Impairment Charge
item.description: Canfor Corp. announced that it will record a non-cash asset write down and impairment charge totaling approximately $321 million in its fourth quarter of 2025 results.

item.title: U.S. Forest Service Announces New Funding Opportunities
item.description: The USDA’s Forest Service announced up to $95 million in competitive grant funding through its Wood Innovations program for projects that advance innovative wood uses.

item.title: March 2026 | Timber Processing
item.description: The post March 2026 appeared first on Timber Processing Magazine.

item.title: Vecoplan AG Announces New CEO | Timber Processing
item.description: Following Eric Jaschke's appointment to Chief Financial Officer in December 2025, Vecoplan AG has also strengthened its Executive Board leadership with Dr. Ralf Guckert taking over as Chief Executive Officer.

item.title: North Alabama Sawmill Announces Closure | Timber Processing
item.description: In north Alabama, Southern Parallel Forest Products Corp. announced plans to shut down its Albertville location, affecting approximately 62 employees.

item.title: Rayonier Announces Wood Products Leadership Transition

item.title: Burton Mill Solutions Acquires Moraska Saw | Timber Processing
item.description: Burton Mill Solutions has acquired Moraska Saw Inc., a respected saw service and repair provider that has served the Upper Peninsula of Michigan and Wisconsin since 1973.
